jobs.title: MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master
jobs.jd_full:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master to join our innovative and dynamic team.

MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master | About You

As a MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master, you will own the integrated delivery plan and governance for a complex MDM and data-modernization initiative. You will coordinate business, data, platform, security, engineering, testing, and leadership stakeholders while ensuring milestones, budget, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT readiness, and transition activities remain on track. You combine disciplined project management with practical Agile leadership and can create transparency, resolve blockers, facilitate timely decisions, and keep a multi-workstream data program moving toward measurable business outcomes.

MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master | Day-to-Day

  • Own and maintain the integrated delivery plan covering discovery, solution design, data profiling, development, testing, deployment, training, hypercare, and handover.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, milestones, resources, actions, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and change-control activities across the program.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release-readiness sessions.
  • Coordinate MDM architects, technical leads, developers, testers, business analysts, data engineers, data owners, stewards, and platform teams around shared priorities and commitments.
  • Lead weekly program-governance meetings, working sessions, status reviews, steering-committee preparation, and stakeholder escalation processes.
  • Manage approvals and decision tracking for business requirements, entity definitions, matching thresholds, survivorship rules, data-quality standards, security readiness, and production deployment.
  • Coordinate SIT, reconciliation, UAT readiness, defect closure, training, knowledge transfer, reverse shadowing, and operational handover activities.
  • Produce executive-ready status reporting that clearly communicates delivery health, accomplishments, risks, dependencies, financial status, and decisions required.

MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Project Management, Technical Program Management, Scrum Master, or enterprise technology-delivery roles, preferably supporting MDM, data, analytics, or cloud programs.
  • Proven experience managing multi-workstream programs across discovery, architecture, engineering, testing, deployment, UAT, and operational transition.
  • Strong Agile/Scrum expertise, including backlog management, sprint planning, delivery metrics, dependency management, release planning, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing project budgets, fixed-price engagements, resource plans, RAID logs, change controls, executive governance, and vendor or client relationships.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills, with the ability to coordinate business, data, engineering, security, platform, and leadership teams.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar delivery-management tools; PMP, CSM, PSM, or SAFe certification is highly valued.

jobs.title: DataTech Client #1 | Technical Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
On behalf of DataTech Client #1, SD Solutions is looking for a talented Technical Project Manager to lead client implementations of a product, a Master Data Management (MDM) platform that runs inside each client's own Databricks workspace and cloud environment.

You will own delivery from kickoff to go-live: planning the work, coordinating Frisco Analytics engineers with client data, security, and business teams, and keeping everyone clear on status, risks, and decisions. Because the platform is deployed in the client's environment, much of the work is shared with client teams, so clear and steady communication matters as much as technical fluency in this role.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities:

Delivery and planning

  • Run two to three concurrent product implementations end to end: scope, plan, schedule, budget, and go-live.
  • Break each engagement into workstreams such as environment setup, source system onboarding, match tuning, data steward enablement, and production cutover.
  • Track milestones, dependencies and resourcing, and fix slippage early rather than reporting it late.
  • Manage scope and change requests through a clear, documented process.

Client and stakeholder coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for client sponsors, data owners, platform administrators, and business data stewards.
  • Coordinate the work clients own in their own environment, such as Databricks workspace access, Unity Catalog permissions, and cloud infrastructure, so it lands on time.
  • Facilitate decisions on match rules, confidence thresholds, and steward review workflows, and record who decided what and why.
  • Lead steering committee meetings and executive readouts.

Security and compliance support

  • Work with Frisco Analytics and product teams to support client security reviews and due diligence questionnaires during onboarding.
  • Ensure implementation team members follow the access, data handling, and confidentiality requirements that apply to client engagements.
  • Route security incidents or concerns to the right owners promptly.

Team leadership

  • Coordinate a delivery team of data engineers and consultants without direct reporting authority.
  • Run sprint ceremonies, stand-ups and retrospectives, and keep project tooling and documentation current.
  • Capture lessons learned to improve Frisco Analytics' implementation playbook.

How you'll communicate

Strong communication is the core skill of this role. You will be the person clients and engineers rely on to know where things stand and what happens next.

  • Translate between audiences. Explain entity matching, golden records, and access permissions to business sponsors in plain language and turn business needs into clear requirements for engineers.
  • Write clearly. Produce concise status reports, RAID logs, decision records, meeting notes, and project plans that a busy executive can scan in two minutes.
  • Run focused meetings. Set agendas, keep discussions on track, close with owners and dates, and send follow-ups the same day.
  • Deliver hard news early. Raise risks, delays, and scope issues directly, with options and a recommendation, before they become surprises.
  • Listen and ask good questions. Uncover unstated requirements, client constraints, and concerns from security and governance teams.
  • Hold firm, kindly. Push back on scope creep and unrealistic dates while keeping the relationship strong.
  • Present with confidence. Lead steering committees, demos, and executive readouts for client leadership.

Requirements:

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years managing client-facing technical or data projects.
  • A track record of delivering data platform, data integration, analytics, or enterprise software implementations on time and within budget.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake or similar) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).
  • Understanding of data concepts such as data quality, data governance, role-based access control, and handling of personal data (PII).
  • Comfort with both Agile and Waterfall delivery, and the judgment to blend them for a client's needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with examples of client-facing reports, presentations, or executive updates you have owned.
  • Experience with project tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or equivalent experience.

Advantages:

  • Experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM), entity resolution, or customer 360 solutions.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, or Databricks workflows.
  • Exposure to AI or machine learning features in enterprise software, including how to explain human review and auditability to clients.
  • Experience supporting client security reviews, vendor due diligence, or compliance requirements such as SOC 2.
  • A PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or similar certification.
  • Consulting or systems integrator background, working across several clients at once.

About the company:

A Databricks-native SaaS platform built to consolidate enterprise data into a single AI-ready layer. The product covers three domains: master data management (MDM), relationship graphs, and product information management (PIM) — all governed and deduplicated via LLMs and running natively on the Databricks Lakehouse.

jobs.title: Sr. Informatics Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
At Personalis, we are transforming the active management of cancer through breakthrough personalized testing. We aim to drive a new paradigm for cancer management, guiding care from biopsy through the life of the patient. Our highly sensitive assays combine tumor-and-normal profiling with proprietary algorithms to deliver advanced insights even as cancer evolves over time. Our products are designed to detect minimal residual disease (MRD) and recurrence at the earliest timepoints, enable selection of targeted therapies based on ultra-comprehensive genomic profiling, and enhance biomarker strategy for drug development. Personalis is based in Fremont, California.

Hybrid: Mon / Tues / Thurs onsite

Summary:

The Sr. Informatics Project Manager leads the planning and delivery of complex informatics and software implementation projects that support clinical diagnostics, laboratory operations, and data management. Projects may include laboratory information management systems (LIMS), clinical data platforms, analytics systems, and software applications.

This role independently manages cross-functional projects, translates business objectives into actionable plans, and coordinates delivery across Informatics, IT, Software Engineering, Clinical Operations, Laboratory Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams. The Senior Project Manager is accountable for project execution, stakeholder alignment, and timely escalation of decisions affecting scope, schedule, resources, or quality.

Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple complex informatics and software projects from initiation through implementation and project closure.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, and deliverables.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to define project scope, requirements, priorities, and success criteria.
  • Assess the impact of proposed changes and manage scope, schedule, and budget adjustments through established change control processes.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies; develop mitigation plans and escalate decisions requiring leadership input.
  • Coordinate delivery across internal teams, software vendors, and implementation partners, holding workstream owners accountable for commitments.
  • Facilitate stakeholder decisions involving competing priorities, technical constraints, and operational needs.
  • Communicate project status, delivery forecasts, risks, trade-offs, and decisions needed to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Manage project execution in accordance with established software development life cycle (SDLC), computer system validation (CSV), and applicable design control procedures.
  • Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to incorporate documentation, validation, approval, and audit readiness activities into project plans.
  • Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and implementation readiness activities.
  • Work with technical and operational teams to assess risks involving data integrity, system performance, laboratory workflows, and clinical impact.
  • Ensure project teams address applicable data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate data migration, user training, go-live planning, and transition to operational support.
  • Improve project management practices, templates, and reporting, and mentor less experienced project team members.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Informatics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5-8 years of experience in project or program management, including delivery of complex software, informatics, or system implementation projects.
  • Experience managing projects within healthcare, diagnostics, life sciences, or another regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects with significant dependencies.
  • Strong knowledge of project planning, resource coordination, budget tracking, risk management, and change control.
  • Experience translating business and operational needs into defined project scope and coordinated delivery plans.
  • Working knowledge of SDLC, system integration, software testing, and implementation processes.
  • Experience partnering with Quality and technical teams on validation, controlled documentation, and implementation approvals.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including presenting project updates and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ability to assess project impacts, recommend proportionate responses, and drive decisions through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience implementing LIMS, clinical data systems, QMS, eQMS, or other laboratory and quality informatics platforms.
  • Experience in diagnostics, genomics, or precision medicine.
  • Familiarity with applicable clinical laboratory, privacy, and computerized system requirements.
  • Experience managing external software vendors and implementation partners.
  • Proficiency with project tracking tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management training.
  • Master’s degree in a relevant discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

Chorus Innovations is a fast-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus’ platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world-class health technology so they can thrive.

Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and evolution of key product lines within the Chorus platform. You will translate market needs, client patterns, and platform capabilities into clear product direction—balancing strategic foresight with the pragmatism needed to drive outcomes in a complex healthcare ecosystem.

You will work at the intersection of R&D, Delivery, and Go-To-Market, ensuring each product area has well-defined goals, reusable templates, and a roadmap that reduces swirl, increases reuse, and unlocks scalable growth. You’ll define problems deeply, synthesize insights from users, clinical experts, research, and stakeholders, and convert them into product requirements, sequencing, and standards that elevate how solutions are built across Chorus.

As a senior leader on the Product team, you will champion clarity, prioritization, and measurable impact. You will shape product narratives, guide cross-functional alignment, and create the artifacts—requirements, stories, templates, and playbooks—that enable both Delivery teams and external partners to move faster with higher quality. Your work ensures that each product line evolves intentionally, customers experience consistent value, and the platform advances toward our long-term vision of intelligent, scalable healthcare infrastructure.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define the vision and roadmap for behavioral health workflows across intake, referrals, crisis response, care coordination, and ongoing case management.
  • Translate real-world behavioral health practices, policy changes, and user insights into clear product requirements, workflow definitions, and reusable templates.
  • Partner with Clinical Solutions, Design, Engineering, and Delivery to ensure features are feasible, well-sequenced, and aligned to product standards and platform capabilities.
  • Identify cross-client patterns to create scalable, repeatable modules that reduce customization and accelerate delivery.
  • Define and evolve mobile-first behavioral health workflows optimized for frontline, in-field, and time-sensitive use cases
  • Drive FHIR-aligned workflow and data model design, ensuring behavioral health workflows integrate cleanly with EHRs, EDWs, crisis systems, and external partners through modern interoperability standards.
  • Prioritize roadmap decisions based on user value, strategic impact, regulatory alignment, and long-term scalability.
  • Measure product performance and user outcomes to inform iteration and continuous improvement.
  • Support GTM, Partner Success, and Delivery teams with clear product artifacts that improve scoping, demos, and client alignment.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience owning features or product lines through discovery, definition, delivery, and iteration.
  • Strong ability to map complex workflows, gathering requirements, synthesizing user research, and translating real-world scenarios into clear product specifications and reusable patterns.
  • Proven success launching workflow-heavy products and driving measurable impact across end users and operational stakeholders.
  • Effective cross-functional partner to Engineering, Design, Clinical Solutions, Delivery, Data, and GTM teams, with strong communication and alignment skills.
  • Analytical thinker skilled at using data, feedback, and usage insights to refine workflows and inform roadmap decisions.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including backlog refinement and iteration planning.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, public health, or similarly complex regulated environments.
  • Experience building and scaling mobile product experiences, including designing workflows for constrained environments (intermittent connectivity, performance, accessibility) and aligning mobile and web experiences within a unified product strategy.
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability, especially FHIR, HL7, and EHR/EDW integration models.
  • BS/BA in a relevant field; technical or clinical background helpful but not required.

Why Join Us?

  • A mission-driven company – be part of a team that is helping to improve people’s lives by democratizing technology development in health!
  • Full medical, dental, vision and life insurance benefits
  • 401K plan
  • Company stock options
  • Unlimited paid vacation
  • Performance bonuses
  • Company support for career and skill development
  • Fun company events and outings
  • Chorus is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity and inclusion

jobs.title: Project Manager, Box Consulting
jobs.jd_full:
WHAT IS BOX? 

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box Consulting is a fast growing team helping customers rapidly deploy, maximize value, and deeply integrate Box into their enterprises. Your proven ability to work creatively and analytically on complex, multi phase engagements with the most strategic of customers will help you build, manage, and scale your team in a highly engaged environment.  Excellent communication, leadership, and management skills enable you to grow the team’s professional development while staying highly engaged with customers - an opportunity for your team to learn the depth of your delivery expertise on the job.

Box is growing fast. Real fast. Every business in the world is looking to modernize the way they work. As the leader in intelligent content management, Box is the only company that can help enterprises transform how people work together.  Your years of experience with project management and business process design, combined with expert knowledge of internal processes and related systems, empower you to be an influential leader within Box Consulting and more broadly across all of Box.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead a portfolio of client facing projects from initiation through closeout, using predictive, Agile, or hybrid approaches as appropriate to the engagement. You will work cross-functionally alongside a team of other individual contributors part of the Box Consulting organization (including: technical consultants, solutions architects, education and change management resources)
  • Establish project objectives, scope, deliverables, success measures, and acceptance criteria in alignment with the Statement of Work (SOW) ensuring a successful delivery
  • Manage project resource and budget allocation to ensure on time delivery of project deliverables, artifacts and scope associated with the implementation
  • Provide status reports with utilization, financial, and project progress analysis on projects and activities
  • Maintain active risk, issue, dependency, decision, and action management, escalating to Project Sponsor as required
  • Identify changes to scope, requirements, assumptions, or timelines, and promptly communicate project impact and produce any necessary artifacts such as Change Orders. Engage Box account team and Solution Consultant based on identified backlog
  • Aligns client strategic objectives with Box’s roadmap to drive expansion. Presents value pursued and realized to executive stakeholders
  • Maintain project backlogs and make recommendations for prioritizing ongoing work and strategic initiatives
  • Own and manage project operations in designated Project & Services Automation (PSA) tool, ensuring project plans, status, resourcing, financials, milestones, deliverables, and supporting documentation are accurate, current, and complete. Reconciliation of project records to be completed on monthly and quarterly basis to ensure projects are in proper standing
  • Provide clear, timely project and portfolio reporting to customer stakeholders, Box Consulting leaders, and executive audiences
  • Demonstrate competency in approved AI tools and automation, applying them thoughtfully to implementation
  • Contribute to project management methodology, internal initiatives, and practice development by using AI to streamline productivity, accelerate analysis and reporting, and increase the consistency of project artifacts
  • Manage project requirements and client expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and lead cross-functional teams
  • Be the “true owner” of the project to BC executives and the wider BC org through multiple channels (All Hands, management meetings, email, Slack, etc).

 

WHO YOU ARE 

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • 4+ years of experience in consulting, project management within the B2B SaaS industry
  • A customer-focused project leader who can work effectively with diverse stakeholders and adapt to different project environments
  • A project leader who is able to “own the customer outcome” and can motivate a team of cross-functional consultants to truly Blow our Customer’s Minds
  • Clearly communicates key project updates to internal and external stakeholders including Executive Leadership
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects (~10) at time with a knack for staying organized and maintaining reliable project records and follow-through
  • An efficiency driver who isn’t afraid to utilize AI to identify and apply approved AI tools and automation to reduce administrative effort, accelerate analysis and reporting, and improve the quality and consistency of project deliverables
  • Able to assess project health, manage financial standing, and maintain scope and timeline alignment with contractual commitments such as an SOW or Change Order
  • Comfortable leading projects using predictive, Agile, or hybrid methods, based on the project context
  • Interested in applying approved AI tools and automation thoughtfully to reduce administrative effort and improve the quality and timeliness of project work
  • Experienced power user of project management tools (e.g. Kantata, SmartSheet, MS Project, etc ), and related tools for communication and productivity (Slack, Google Calendar, etc)
  • Preferred qualifications - Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PRINCE2, PMI-CPMAI, Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or comparable project management or Agile certification
